contradiction_fused.review_b_finding: F2 call identity is strong but semantic EffectRequest identity is missing.
contradiction_fused.review_b_conflicting_next_step: Its current next action still describes canonical PENDING evidence feeding a separate F2 executor input, which the admitted EntityOS API does not expose.

effect_gate_execute_semantics: validates capability, session/generation, replay and lease constraints
calls EffectJournal.begin and creates PENDING before any state.noop or EntityOSBridge action
executes the effect itself inside the same EffectGate.execute call
finalizes VERIFIED, DENIED or FAILED before normal return
for entityos.exec acquires and releases the canonical lease inside execute
source_observation.effect_journal_recovery: Residual PENDING rows become UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART; recovery never authorizes blind replay.
source_observation.f2_current_gap: EffectCallIntent and related PRE/POST correlation types bind call lineage but not EffectRequest(user_id, session_id, capability, target, argv, expected_generation).

pre_call.digest_rule: request_sha256 = SHA256(UTF8(canonical JSON of schema-tagged exact semantic fields)); object keys sorted, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN; argv order preserved; null distinguished from absent; strings validated before hashing.
pre_call.security_rule: request_sha256 is correlation evidence, not policy authority. Semantic fields must originate from the typed non-model authority/request path required by EntityOS; F2 must not let model text self-grant capability or authority.
pre_call.binding_rule: Bind request_sha256 to the exact F2 call identity before invoking the canonical adapter. Any later semantic mutation with unchanged call IDs is a pre-call rejection.

canonical_call.operation: Construct the exact EntityOS EffectRequest from the already-bound semantic object, then invoke the attested EffectGate.execute exactly once.
canonical_call.authority_identity_rule: Verify the 9.13 attestation plus EffectGate, EffectJournal, UnifiedDB schema and API tuple before the call; a single-module authority_ref is insufficient if it can omit journal/store identity.

post_call.normal_return: Bind returned canonical effect_id and a structured result/outcome receipt to the same request_sha256 and F2 call identity; do not mint external-world verification merely from normal return.
post_call.pre_journal_rejection: A canonical policy/session/generation/replay rejection that occurs before EffectJournal.begin must remain a typed non-dispatch rejection with no invented effect_id.
post_call.journaled_denial_or_failure: If the canonical call created an effect row and finalized DENIED/FAILED, preserve that exact canonical effect_id/status lineage; do not collapse it into a pre-journal rejection.
post_call.ambiguous_no_return: If the canonical call may have crossed EffectJournal.begin/action boundaries but no correlated return is available, F2 outcome is UNKNOWN. Recovery owns reconciliation; no automatic retry.
